units: <cite ref="Pesachim 34a:1">Pes. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ של בית וכ׳</he> was the baker for the house of Rabbi.
Ib. 46ᵃ לג׳ ולתפלה וכ׳ in order to get a kneader (that observes levitical purity), for prayer (in a synagogue) and for washing hands (for a meal) one is bound to walk four mils (no more).
<cite ref="Ketubot 72a:14">Keth. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>פלוני ג׳ תקן וכ׳</he> a certain kneader prepared for me the dough according to the law of Ḥallah.
